name: agent-pet
description: A 3D Gaussian-splat desktop pet that acts out what your coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) is doing.

interface.shortDescription: A 3D desktop pet that acts out what Codex is doing
interface.longDescription: A desktop pet that thinks, types, reads and runs commands along with Codex, pleads when Codex needs your approval, and collapses out of breath when the turn is done. Runs entirely on your machine.
